page.layout: One printed page on the scan, almost entirely covered by pasted marbled paper (red, blue and cream pieces, upper right and lower centre). Faint traces of print show through underneath, but no line can be read. Dark cloth edges at the top right and bottom are the book's binding and the digitiser's edge, not part of the page.
page.notes: No legible text. The printed text beneath the marbled paste-downs is only faintly visible as grey marks and cannot be read letter by letter, so nothing is transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature can be seen. Dark blue cloth at the top right and bottom and the yellowed board edges are binding and scan edges, not printed matter.
